name: Hamas Attack on Southern Israel
target: Kibbutzim, military bases, and Nova music festival in southern Israel
description: Hamas launched a large-scale surprise attack from Gaza into southern Israel, killing approximately 1,200 people and taking 251 hostages. This triggered Israel's ground invasion of Gaza.

name: Israel Launches Ground Invasion of Gaza
target: Northern Gaza Strip
casualties: Tens of thousands killed over following months
description: Israel launched a ground invasion of the Gaza Strip, beginning in the north and progressively expanding. The campaign caused massive civilian casualties and near-total destruction of infrastructure.

name: Gaza Ceasefire Agreement Takes Effect
target: Cessation of hostilities and phased hostage-prisoner exchange
casualties: N/A (over 46,000 Palestinians killed by this date)
description: A ceasefire agreement brokered by Qatar, Egypt, and the US took effect, establishing phased hostage-prisoner exchanges and partial Israeli withdrawal. The agreement has been repeatedly violated since.

name: Gaza Disease Outbreak: 9,300+ Chickenpox Cases
target: 130+ health facilities across Gaza Strip
casualties: 9,300+ cases; indirect deaths from collapsed healthcare system
description: Over 9,300 chickenpox cases were recorded across 130 health facilities in Gaza, reflecting the near-total collapse of the healthcare system. Only 3 hospitals remain fully functional in the entire territory.

name: Hamas Announces Civilian Governance Handover
parties: NCAG (National Committee for Administration of Gaza)
target: Civilian governance of Gaza Strip
description: Hamas announced via Cairo that it would hand over civilian governance in Gaza to the NCAG, but without a disarmament timeline. Israel rejected the move as insufficient for its security demands.

name: EU Announces 900M Euro Gaza Recovery Fund
target: Gaza early recovery and reconstruction
description: The European Union announced 900 million euros in funding for Gaza early recovery, the largest single international financial commitment to post-ceasefire reconstruction.

name: West Bank Settler Violence Wave: Tell/Nablus
target: Tell village near Nablus; spread to 5 towns across West Bank
description: A settler raid and shootout in Tell village near Nablus killed 4 Palestinians and 2 Israelis, triggering the most intense settler violence wave of 2026. Over the following days, settlers attacked across 5 towns, and 70+ Palestinians were detained in sweeping IDF raids.

name: Settler Revenge Attacks: Mosques Burned in Qusra, Kur
target: Rahma Mosque in Qusra, mosque in Kur, homes in Beit Furik
description: In retaliation for the Tell incident, settlers burned the Rahma Mosque in Qusra and set fire to a mosque in Kur. Homes were burned in Beit Furik. Four illegal outposts were established by settlers during the violence.

name: Netanyahu Rejects US 15-Point Gaza Roadmap
target: US-proposed phased withdrawal and disarmament plan
description: Netanyahu rejected a US-led 15-point roadmap for Gaza, declaring Israel would not withdraw until Hamas was genuinely disarmed. The rejection was described by analysts as threatening endless war and undermining the ceasefire framework.

name: Israeli Airstrikes Kill 3 Including Child in Gaza
target: az-Zawayda, Shujaiyya, Khan Younis
casualties: 3 killed including a 4-year-old child, multiple wounded
description: Israeli airstrikes killed 3 people including a 4-year-old child across multiple locations in Gaza. Netanyahu threatened intensification of operations over kite launches from Gaza into Israeli territory.

name: Strikes Hit Water Plant, Mosque, UNICEF Warehouse
target: Water plant, mosque, and UNICEF warehouse in Bureij, Deir el-Balah, Khan Younis
description: Israeli strikes hit civilian infrastructure including a water treatment plant, a mosque, and a UNICEF warehouse storing nutrition supplies for children and pregnant women. Seven people were killed including two children.

name: IDF Demolishes Tell Shooter's Family Home
target: Home of Farouq Ramadan in Tell village
description: The IDF demolished the family home of Farouq Ramadan, identified as the Palestinian shooter in the July 24 Tell incident, as a punitive measure. Punitive home demolitions are considered collective punishment under international law.

name: Knesset Dissolves, Sets October 27 Election
target: Israeli parliament
description: Israel's parliament voted to dissolve itself and set a general election for 27 October 2026, putting Netanyahu's handling of Gaza and the Iran war before voters.

name: Netanyahu Orders Evacuation of UNRWA Compound in Kafr Aqab
target: UNRWA compound, Kafr 'Aqab, East Jerusalem
description: Netanyahu ordered the evacuation of the UNRWA compound in Kafr 'Aqab in East Jerusalem, blaming the agency for the October 7 attacks. The same day far-right MK Zvi Sukkot was filmed smashing a Palestinian monument in Madama under IDF escort.

name: Settlers Attack Qusra Home Again; Troops Beat Residents
target: Palestinian home in Qusra, Nablus governorate
description: Witnesses said settlers staged a new attack on a home in Qusra and IDF troops then fired tear gas and handcuffed, blindfolded and beat residents inside. The same day masked settlers attacked an NBC News crew in Jalud, drawing an alarmed Foreign Press Association statement.

name: Israel Demolishes Al-Tabban Village in Masafer Yatta
target: Al-Tabban hamlet, Firing Zone 918, South Hebron Hills
description: Israeli authorities demolished the Palestinian village of Al-Tabban in the southern West Bank, citing the Supreme Court ruling on Firing Zone 918. Structures in nearby Jinba were razed on 23 September under the same ruling as evictions in Masafer Yatta accelerated. Coordinates approximate.

name: Netanyahu Orders Unauthorized Settler Outposts Removed
target: About 100 unauthorized West Bank settler outposts (per Ynet)
description: Under US pressure, Netanyahu ordered unauthorized settler outposts dismantled, two sources told Reuters; Ynet put the number at about 100. It followed US Ambassador Mike Huckabee calling violent settlers terrorists. Smotrich said the instruction covered places built in Areas A and B. No start date was given.

name: 12 States Incl. UK, France, Canada Sanction Settlement Trade
target: Trade in goods from Israeli West Bank settlements
description: Twelve countries said in a joint foreign-ministers' statement they would restrict trade in goods from settlements they call illegal under international law, citing settlement expansion and settler violence. Israel responded by ordering the UK consulate in East Jerusalem closed. Pin at Paris (France led the push; no single venue — inference).

name: War-Damaged Building Collapses in Gaza City, Killing 16
target: War-damaged residential building, Gaza City
description: A building damaged during the war collapsed in Gaza City, killing at least 16, AP reported, as perilous living conditions persist during the truce. Typed 'political' as a humanitarian milestone (schema has no humanitarian type).

name: US Bars Abbas and PA Delegation From UN General Assembly
target: Abbas and PA/PLO delegation to UNGA
description: The State Department sanctioned PA and PLO officials and barred President Mahmoud Abbas and his delegation from attending the UN General Assembly in New York, accusing them of breaching US law.

name: Gaza Schools Reopen for First Time Since War Began
target: Schools across the Gaza Strip
description: Schools in the Gaza Strip reopened for the first time since the war began in October 2023. Humanitarian milestone; single Palestinian outlet source.

name: Israeli Killed in Shooting Attack Near Halamish
target: Israeli man near Halamish settlement
description: An Israeli man shot in a West Bank attack near Halamish died of his wounds; the IDF said the Palestinian gunman was later captured at a hospital.

name: Ramming on Route 443 Seriously Wounds Son of Israel's US Envoy
target: Israeli reservist Neriya Leiter at Maccabim junction, Route 443
description: A car-ramming at Maccabim junction on Route 443 seriously wounded IDF reservist Neriya Leiter, son of Israel's ambassador to the US Yechiel Leiter; troops shot the attacker dead.

name: Israel Kills Qassam Northern Gaza Commander Izz al-Din al-Beik
target: Apartment building, Nasr neighbourhood, Gaza City
casualties: 6-7 killed that day incl. al-Beik (Gaza officials)
description: An Israeli airstrike on a Gaza City apartment building killed Izz al-Din al-Beik, Qassam Brigades commander for northern Gaza and successor to Ahmed al-Ghandour. Gaza officials said Israeli fire killed six or seven that day. Al Jazeera reports Israel has escalated strikes in recent weeks while disarmament and withdrawal talks stall.

name: Hamas, PIJ and Dahlan Form Electoral Alliance
target: 2026 Palestinian legislative election
description: Hamas and Islamic Jihad agreed an unlikely electoral coalition with ex-Fatah strongman Mohammed Dahlan for the planned Palestinian legislative election, AP reported. The election was cancelled by Abbas on 10 October. Venue not confirmed; pin at Gaza City is a placeholder.

name: Settlers Shoot Dead Palestinian at Home in Yasuf
target: Mashour Yassin, 51, at his home in Yasuf
description: Settlers shot and killed Mashour Yassin, 51, at his home in Yasuf, the village council head said; two others were wounded. The IDF said it opened fire after Palestinians threw rocks at settlers, and Israeli authorities said they were investigating.

name: 19-Year-Old Shot Dead in Kobar After Settler Gate Clash
target: Young Palestinians trying to open a settler-erected gate at Kobar
description: Young Palestinians trying to pass a gate settlers had erected at Kobar were attacked and a clash followed; the mayor said the army shot dead a 19-year-old. Settler violence continued into the olive harvest, with Defense Minister Katz banning pro-Palestinian activists from helping harvesters on 8 October.

name: Abbas Cancels Nov. 28 Legislative Vote, Sets Sept. 2027
target: Palestinian legislative and presidential elections
description: Abbas formally cancelled the 28 November 2026 legislative election, WAFA said, and set combined presidential and legislative elections for 11 September 2027, citing Israeli restrictions and attacks in Gaza, the West Bank and East Jerusalem. He had committed to the vote under donor pressure as the PA sought a governing role in Gaza.
